summary: A general-purpose synth and sequencer firmware for the FM-1 with four tracks, many sound engines and a browser installer and editor.
features: Four synth tracks, each with its own engine and sequence
Engines include ANALOG, FM6, PHASE, WHEEL, GRAIN, PHYS, SLICE and DRUM
Step sequencer with parameter locks, ratchets, chance and song sections
Web installer and SysEx web editor with full device backup
Installer can return the unit to the official V15 firmware
1.8.2 beta adds support for newer units with UC25HQ80 flash
